//: Build profiles for EAS, Expo's hosted Android and iOS builders.
The point of building on EAS rather than locally is that the Android SDK,
the NDK and a signing keystore all live on their machines instead of
yours. `preview` is the one to use: it produces an installable .apk.
The default for a store submission is an .aab, which a phone cannot open,
and finding that out after a twenty-minute build is a rite of passage
npm i -g eas-cli && eas login && eas init
Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to your deployed site first — see the env blocks
